# Steamboat Pilot & Today

> > Local news and community coverage for Steamboat Springs, Routt County, and Northwest Colorado's Western Slope region.

The Steamboat Pilot & Today serves as the primary news source for Steamboat Springs and surrounding Routt County communities, covering local government, outdoor recreation, ski industry developments, community events, and regional issues affecting Colorado's mountain communities. Coverage spans from housing policy and environmental concerns to high school sports and cultural happenings in the Yampa Valley.

## Key Topics

- Steamboat Springs
- Routt County
- Colorado legislation
- Affordable housing
- Steamboat Resort
- Winter sports and skiing
- Northwest Colorado
- Yampa Valley
- Community events
- Drought and snowpack
- Western Slope
- Local government
- High school athletics
- Wildlife and environment
- Workforce housing

## Local Government & Policy

- [Colorado legislature passes bill to loosen restrictions on how counties fund affordable housing](https://www.steamboatpilot.com/news/colorado-bill-restrictions-fund-affordable-housing): CO Senate Bill 1 on county affordable housing funding heads to Gov. Polis
- [Colorado considers earlier than normal activation of Drought Task Force as snowpack continues to lag behind](https://www.steamboatpilot.com/news/colorado-drought-task-force-snowpack-temperatures): CO Drought Task Force may activate early due to record-low snowpack levels
- [Oak Creek officials look toward code enforcement overhaul](https://www.steamboatpilot.com/news/oak-creek-officials-look-toward-code-enforcement-overhaul): Oak Creek shifts nuisance cases to municipal court in code overhaul

## Ski Industry & Mountain Recreation

- [Ski Corp. to begin charging for Meadows parking next season](https://www.steamboatpilot.com/news/ski-corp-to-begin-charging-for-meadows-parking-next-season): Steamboat Resort to implement paid parking at Meadows Lot for 2026-27 season
- [Warm storm delivers modest totals to Colorado's northern mountains](https://www.steamboatpilot.com/news/colorado-snow-northern-mountains-resorts): Warm storm brings up to 10 inches snow to northern CO mountains Friday
- [Warm weather delays ice formation at local lakes and reservoirs](https://www.steamboatpilot.com/news/warm-weather-delays-ice-formation-at-local-lakes-and-reservoirs): Warm weather delays ice fishing at Routt County reservoirs and lakes
